conviction_note: Guide arithmetic and two straight modest beats point to another small Q3 revenue beat (print_vs_bar about +3%). But this name sold its last three beat-and-reiterate prints (-0.6, -2.6, -5.9), and it ran +21% in the five sessions into the print with no catalyst I could find. Against that, roughly 17% of float was short in August. That leaves p_up at 50. The findings sum is +0.7, made of small offsetting items. The scaled number is 0 because the reaction function vetoes the fundamental lean. abs_move is 10%, below the 12% median: the last three non-preannounced prints moved under 6%, but Mint/3D and a possible first 2027 view add tail risk.
bar: Q3 2026 revenue about $34.75M, the average of 11 analysts with a range of $33.9-35.58M, EPS about -$0.50 (Yahoo analysis page, snapshot around 2026-09-18, https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/BBNX/analysis). Earnings Whispers shows EPS -$0.55 (https://www.earningswhispers.com/epsdetails/BBNX). Company FY2026 guide is $131-136M, reiterated 2026-07-29 (https://investors.betabionics.com/static-files/92b6384a-5776-465d-b6a2-adfc5c050c60, via search snippet). With H1 at $59.6M (Q1 $27.6M + Q2 $32.0M), that implies H2 of $71.4-76.4M. The revenue bar has one estimate source but is consistent with the company guide, so it is treated as a semi-sourced bar and the findings are kept small.
positioning_check: Short interest was 7.5M shares, 5.5 days to cover, at the 2026-08-14 settlement (FINRA via https://curvedtrading.com/stocks/bbnx/short-interest/). Equibles shows 16.9% of float with 6.0 days to cover, undated (https://equibles.com/stocks/bbnx/shortinterest). The float grew by about 8.7M shares plus 1.04M pre-funded warrants in the Sept 2026 offering, so the current percentage is probably a bit lower. Still a crowded short. No usable option chain (no_paired_strikes), so there is no skew. Run-up is +21.4% over 5 days and +10.9% over 20 days, spot $21.53, 32.7% below the 52-week high.

findings.finding: Guide arithmetic points to a modest Q3 revenue beat. Q1 was $27.6M (+57%) and Q2 $32.0M (+38%), against Q2 consensus of about $31.4-31.5M, a beat of about 2%. The FY guide of $131-136M implies $71.4-76.4M for H2. Management said on the Q2 call that Q3 new patient starts would exceed Q2 and Q4 would be seasonally stronger, and pharmacy-channel recurring revenue compounds. Q3 consensus of $34.75M is only +27.5% YoY against Q3 2025's $27.25M, versus 38% growth in Q2, so a print around $35.5-36M (+2-4% vs bar) looks more likely than a miss.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Small revenue beats with the guide reiterated or raised were sold or flat in 2026: Q2 (beat about 2%, guide reiterated) -5.93%, Q1 (guide raised) -0.57%, Q4'25 -2.58%. The large positive reactions (+10 to +27%) were in 2025, when beats came with raises.
findings.why_not_priced: Consensus at $34.75M sits in the lower-middle of the guide-implied H2 run-rate, so the street already models a beat-able number. A visible pricing of the beat would be consensus drifting above $36M, and the snapshot shows the high estimate at $35.58M. The +21% 5-day run-up may already be pricing a beat, which is why this is sized small.
findings.independence: The Q2 numbers and guide reiteration come from a separate document, the Q2 release of 2026-07-29 (https://www.marketbeat.com/earnings/reports/2026-7-29-beta-bionics-inc-stock/). The Q3 > Q2 starts commentary is from third-party call summaries (https://stocktaper.com/earningsCallSummary/BBNX/2026/Q2). The finding shares the company guide with the guidance finding below.

findings.finding: FY2026 revenue guide of $131-136M was only reiterated in July despite a Q2 beat. Gross-margin guide was raised to 58.5-59.5%, and PBP share of starts is guided at 37-39%. If Q3 lands near $36M, YTD would be about $95.6M, needing only $35.4M in Q4 for the low end, which is below Q3. That sets up a raise of at least the low end, the line this name's 2025 rallies were paid on. A second straight reiteration would repeat the Q2 setup that fell 5.9%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2025-07-29 and 2025-10-28, beat and raise: +14.3% and +10.3%. 2026-07-29, beat and reiterate: -5.9%. 2026-01-08 (preliminary Q4 plus a 2026 outlook with a new-patient-start shortfall): -37%.
findings.why_not_priced: Whether management raises or holds is not knowable from public data. The consensus FY figure of about $133.15M (Earnings Whispers) is at the guide midpoint, so a raise is not in consensus. If a raise were priced, FY consensus would sit at or above the top of the guide.
findings.independence: Shares the company guide with the reported-quarter finding, so it is sized on the guidance line only. The Insulet Q2 US guide cut citing 'what we're learning as we scale in type 2' (https://www.biospace.com/press-releases/insulet-reports-second-quarter-2026-results) is a sector counterweight to a raise.

findings.finding: Beta Bionics raised $172.5M gross at $17.25 on 2026-09-15/17 (common, pre-funded warrants and full greenshoe; 52.6-53.9M shares out after). Proceeds are for Mint commercialization and manufacturing scale to at least 1.5M disposables in 2027. The 424B5 'Recent developments' section, written 2.5 months into Q3, carries no preliminary results or warning. Management raised equity with near-complete Q3 visibility and a pending securities class action, which argues against a large known shortfall. Cash, about $225M at June 30 plus about $160M net, removes funding overhang into the Mint launch.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior print followed a raise this closely. The stock fell about 6.6% overnight on pricing and recovered about 6% the next day (RTTNews).
findings.why_not_priced: The raise itself is fully priced. The inference about Q3 visibility is not stated anywhere. It would be visibly priced if previews cited the absence of a preliminary in the deal, and none I found do.
findings.independence: Mint FDA clearance ahead of schedule on 2026-09-14 explains why the money was raised then (https://www.medtechdive.com/news/beta-bionics-insulin-patch-pump-gets-fda-nod/830332/).

findings.finding: BBNX ran +21.4% in the 5 sessions and +10.9% in the 20 sessions into the print (sealed baseline). I found no company news, analyst action or peer print in Oct 20-27 to explain it (Tandem reports Nov 5, Insulet Nov 4). The stock carries a higher bar into a print whose last three beat-and-reiterate reactions were negative. This is offset by a crowded short of about 17% of float, 5.5 days to cover in August, which could squeeze on any raise.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 came in after an up-move and was sold 5.9% on a beat and reiterate. Before 2026-01-08 the stock had rallied and then fell 37% on the outlook.
findings.why_not_priced: The run-up is itself the price. The finding is that the bar moved up about 20% with no fundamental news, so a merely in-line beat has less room. If this were already discounted, previews would flag elevated expectations; I found none.
findings.independence: Run-up figures come from the sealed baseline, a separate source from the short-interest data. The unexplained run-up was searched (finviz/biopharmawatch/drugdeliverybusiness) and nothing was found.

findings.finding: Insulet cut its 2026 US Omnipod growth guide on 2026-08-05, from 20-22% to 17-19%, guiding Q3 US Omnipod to +14-16%, and cited 'what we're learning as we scale in type 2'. That is a read on the type-2, pharmacy-channel pump demand that drives BBNX's PBP growth (+153% in Q2).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: BBNX fell 5.9% the week of its own Q2 print and Insulet's cut; there is no separate BBNX reaction to the Insulet cut.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced since August. It is a proxy: BBNX is still taking share from MDI, about 70% of starts, and is far smaller, so transmission is unconfirmed.
findings.independence: Proxy from a competitor's document. Neither BBNX nor a direct counterparty has confirmed it.

findings.finding: Mint was FDA-cleared on 2026-09-14 for a full US launch in Q1 2027, pharmacy channel only. Patients and prescribers who prefer a patch pump may defer iLet starts into Q4 2026 and Q1 2027 (an Osborne effect on the tubed iLet). That is a risk to Q4 new patient starts and so to a guide raise.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior BBNX product transition to compare against.
findings.why_not_priced: Inference only: no company statement or channel data confirms deferral. If it were priced, Q4 consensus would sit below the guide-implied run-rate.
findings.independence: None. This is inference from the launch timing.

findings.finding: The 3D Intelligence algorithm 510(k) was submitted in September, and the company expects to commercialize iLet 3D in the US by end-2026. Any clearance or timing update on the call, or an early read on Mint pre-launch demand and coverage (target of at least 50% of insured lives in year one per the prospectus), is a forward catalyst the release can carry.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Mint clearance day (2026-09-14/15) closed up 14.9%.
findings.why_not_priced: Clearance timing is not known. A 510(k) submitted in September could clear within the end-2026 window, but nothing has been announced (searches turned up no clearance).
findings.independence: Corroborated by the 424B5 recent developments (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001674632/000119312526393320/d108271d424b5.htm), which is the same company-sourced fact.

outside_window.finding: Pending securities class action, disclosed in the Sept 2026 424B5 'Recent developments' and likely tied to the Jan 2026 37% drop. Any ruling is not dated inside the window.
Tandem's Q3 2026 print on Nov 5 and Insulet's on Nov 4 will give direct competitor reads on Q3 pump demand, both after the exit window.

baseline_tension: There is no option skew. My evidence (a guide-arithmetic beat, no warning in the September raise) leans positive, but the +21% run-up and the habit of selling beat-and-reiterate prints cut against it. The crowded short cuts against a negative, so p_up stays at 50.
lessons_applied: Lesson 1 (a verified fact is not a predicted reaction): the reported-quarter beat finding was cut from +1.0 to +0.5, because the last three beats were sold.
Lesson 5 (an unexplained move is worth little) and lesson 7 (crowded short): the unexplained run-up positioning finding was cut from -1.0 to -0.5.
Lesson 5 (inference/proxy): the Mint Osborne-effect inference was cut from -0.4 to -0.3.
Lesson 6 (bar): the revenue bar is a single estimate source plus the company guide, so all sizes stay small. Nothing else changed.
